---
title: "xuct"
---

## Description

Check if variable values match Codelists tab of spec and CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`invar`**

: Name of the variable in input dataset to be checked

  *Required:* Yes

**`codelist`**

: Codelist name as specified in ID column in codelists metadata file

  *Required:* Yes

**`subset`**

: Logical condition to be used in where clause, when variable may have multiple codelists

  *Required:* No

**`filename`**

: Codelists metadata file (Codelists tab of spec converted to .csv file)

  *Required:* No

**`filepath`**

: Path to codelists metadata file

  *Required:* No

**`ctfile`**

: CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology file converted to CSV

  *Required:* No

**`ctpath`**

: Path to CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology file, if misc._ct.sas7bdat is missing

  *Required:* No

**`checkct`**

: Flag that determines whether values should be checked for compliance with CDISC SDTM CT

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `Y`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xuct(cm,CMCAT,CMCAT,checkct=N);
%xuct(ex,EXDOSU,EX.UNIT,checkct=Y);
%xuct(lb,LBORRESU,LB.UNIT,checkct=Y);
```
